migration.name: 20260805030000_resolve_unmanaged_identity_lifecycle_issues
migration.backfill: status flip only — no row is created or deleted, no id, scope FK, summary, or detection timestamp is changed. Three predicates set open->resolved with resolvedAt=NOW() on catalog_match_ambiguous / lifecycle_unverified rows: (1) issueKey carries a positional observed token (arp:, arp-host:, unifi-client:, prom:, prom-target:), matching hasObservedToken() in estate-observation-class.ts; (2) issueKey carries a positional container: segment, clearing rows stranded when the Docker suppression `continue`d without resolving; (3) inventoryEntityId is NULL or dangling, which no reconcile path can reach because reconciliation resolves by issueKey derived from entities present in a sweep. Managed estate with a genuine identity or lifecycle gap is deliberately left OPEN because it is real operator signal. Tokens match positionally so managed names containing the letters (promotions-engine, sharp-imaging) are never matched. Non-destructive and idempotent: already-resolved rows are not re-selected.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: no lifecycle change to the underlying InventoryEntity or any operator-facing record: only the derived quality-issue status transitions open->resolved for issues describing merely-observed estate, Docker-origin subjects, or subjects whose entity row is gone. firstDetectedAt, lastDetectedAt, scope FKs, and summary are preserved; rows remain for audit.

fields.reason: resolve identity/lifecycle issues that no operator action can close, and scope both types to the managed estate exactly as stale_entity was scoped in 20260723020000; going forward evaluateInventoryQuality gates both on classifyEntityObservation(...) === 'managed'
fields.provenance: measured on the live install by EXECUTING the detector (deriveInventoryEvidenceSnapshot -> persisted-first merge -> evaluateInventoryQuality) over all 341 open rows joined to an entity, not by querying stored columns — the method that produced three wrong magnitude predictions earlier in BI-A3D12F85. MAC OUI enrichment resolved 65 of 65 burned-in MACs to a vendor and 0 of 119 locally-administered (randomised) MACs; all 101 ARP hosts swept on 2026-08-05 carry randomised MACs, which have no OUI and therefore no vendor, catalog identity or support lifecycle by construction. Of 389 open rows of these two types: 180 are observed-estate, 19 are Docker-origin strays, 48 have a NULL or dangling entity FK, and 21 describe genuinely managed gear (4 UniFi APs, 1 gateway, 1 switch, 1 linux host, the docker socket, 3 NICs, 2 subnets) and are left OPEN.
fields.operatorDecision: Operator signed off 2026-08-05 on scoping emission to the managed estate (BI-A3D12F85 option B) together with re-enabling the arp_scan discovery connection for topology and presence coverage.
